credential_authority: the SKAP Vault inside KV is the only PII and credential store for every user, including the StegVerse ecosystem's own; no secret or token is referenced, introduced or moved by this fold
invariants: Every workflow file is registered in surfaces[]; an unregistered or changed one fails closed (tests/test_workflow_surface_registry.py).
A new check is a group in tools/tasks/task_catalog.json, never a new workflow file.
The stable dispatcher carries no workflow_dispatch, schedule, repository_dispatch, issues or workflow_run trigger; a kept surface is pinned by sha256 and unchanged by the fold.

G17 documented exception: above 2 workflow files, every kept surface other than the dispatcher carries an exception record (lifecycle and technical-necessity justification); the count never exceeds exception_repository_workflow_count_max (3).

unregistered_workflow_outcome.required_evidence_or_repair: register the file in control/workflow-surface-registry.json surfaces[] or fold it into tools/tasks/task_catalog.json

ceiling_fail_closed.required_evidence_or_repair: this is batch 3 of the G17 surface reduction for this repository. Batch 1 folded 15 credential-free validators (154 to 140), batch 2 folded 17 more (140 to 123), and batch 3 folds 13 more pull_request/push validators that need no credential and return ALLOW through the catalog runner on main's tree (123 to 110). 109 surfaces remain byte-unchanged. Each carries an exception record naming its disposition: KEEP_PENDING_LATER_BATCH for validators handled in later batch PRs (including validators that fail on main's tree or re-initialize the checkout, which need their own repair first), and writers, credential-bound, workflow_run and issue-triggered surfaces that stay kept. Each later batch lowers workflow_count and replaces this record with its exact new count. The kept writers and credential-bound surfaces need their own admitted repair to retire, and their credentials belong only in the SKAP Vault inside KV.
